title: Complete PM OS readiness criteria
note: Every criterion is either verifiable by a command that exits 0, or it is not earned. A criterion with no verify command scores nothing and carries the task id that would build it. Points are earned only by criteria whose verify command runs and passes on this checkout; there is no partial credit and no credit for documentation. tools/readiness.py computes the score from this file by running the commands; editing a status by hand does not change the score.

criteria.title: Six-stage loop, six gates, and every stage template present and internally consistent
A workspace can be created and every shipped template installed into its canonical folder

Entities with independent lifecycles: organization, product, initiative, opportunity, experiment, release, decision, risk, approval, dependency, portfolio allocation. Several initiatives progress concurrently through different stages
criteria.blocker: STATE.md models one product at one stage with one next question. There is no initiative entity, so nothing can hold two lifecycles at once.

criteria.title: One canonical destination resolver, shared by initializer and runner, agreeing on every manifest route
A generated workspace has zero broken links
Zero links point at a blank source template when a filled workspace artifact exists (semantic drift)
The rewriter and the gate read one link grammar: inline, reference, titles, angle brackets, spaces, anchors
Every route declares a typed kind the runner implements, and the manifest agrees with the router table
The runner branches on route kind; only document-producing kinds write, and the structure check runs only where a template exists
criteria.verify: python3 -m unittest discover -s harness -p test_runner.py -k AuditRegression

criteria.title: The generated Claude Code adapter matches the manifest, route for route
The desktop adapter self-test passes
The Conductor is a persistent multi-turn state machine: one question, persisted answer, validated transition, resume mid-bank, and completion. Not a single stateless call
criteria.blocker: The interactive kind stops the runner demanding a filled template, which was the contradiction. It does not yet persist a question cursor, validate a transition, or resume: the runner is still one call per invocation.

categories.title: Transactions, concurrency, queue, memory, and recovery

criteria.title: A failed multi-file commit leaves the workspace as it was; failure is injected before and after each replace
criteria.verify: python3 -m unittest discover -s harness -p test_runner.py -k failed_commit

criteria.title: Concurrent journal writers preserve every valid event; no silent lost update
criteria.verify: python3 -m unittest discover -s harness -p test_runner.py -k concurrent

criteria.title: Deferred work writes a durable, deduplicated job record and exits with a deferred status, never success
criteria.verify: python3 -m unittest discover -s harness -p test_runner.py -k queued

criteria.title: Durable queue with lease, heartbeat, owner, priority, retry policy, cancellation and dead-letter state, plus a worker that dequeues and recovers after a crash
criteria.blocker: The job record is a record, not a queue. There is no worker, lease, retry schedule, cancellation, or dead-letter transition.

criteria.title: Process-level crash recovery: kill during commit, queue write and memory update; a reader observes the complete prior or complete new state
criteria.blocker: Rollback is covered by in-process failure injection only. No test kills a real process mid-commit.

criteria.title: Two-level durable memory: OS memory and isolated per-task memory, append-only events, rebuildable state, scoped retrieval, and a test that two tasks cannot contaminate each other
criteria.blocker: Not implemented. STATE.md is the only durable memory and it is per-product, not per-task.

categories.title: Governance, security, privacy, regulatory evidence, and audit

criteria.title: A document claiming Approved with unticked gate evidence fails the gate
Removing a mandatory gate criterion fails the suite
Provenance-aware metric checking: a sourced observed value passes, an unresolved example literal fails
Secret scanning across the tree, and no credential written to artifact, log or journal
Write boundary: output confined to products/, path traversal in a product slug refused
criteria.verify: python3 -m unittest discover -s harness -p test_runner.py -k slug

criteria.title: Identity, RBAC, least privilege, and an immutable audit trail with approval identities and evidence hashes
criteria.blocker: No identity abstraction exists. A gate is signed by a person editing a file; nothing binds a signature to an actor or hashes the evidence it was given on.

criteria.title: Regulated evidence packs: approver authority, timestamp, source hash, audit export, revocation and re-approval enforced at runtime
criteria.blocker: The regulated overlay is a document contract. Nothing enforces approver authority or produces an export.

criteria.title: Multi-user assignments, comments, mentions, approvals, and explicit conflict handling on concurrent edits
criteria.blocker: Not implemented. The advisory lock serializes writers on one filesystem and says nothing about two people on two machines.

criteria.title: Portfolio prioritization, capacity allocation, sequencing and rollups across products, preserving individual history
criteria.blocker: Not implemented. Depends on the initiative entity in T-07.

criteria.title: Cross-machine concurrency: compare-and-swap or merge, with an explicit conflict rather than a lost update
criteria.blocker: Not implemented. flock is machine-local and advisory.

categories.title: Integrations, analytics, experiments, and research operations

criteria.title: Versioned adapters with contract tests for issue tracking, source control, analytics, research storage and notifications
criteria.blocker: No adapter exists for any integration class.

criteria.title: At least one representative adapter per claimed class verified against an approved sandbox
criteria.blocker: EXTERNAL: requires sandbox credentials and authorization this session does not have.

criteria.title: Metric ingestion and experiment outcomes linked to a recorded decision
criteria.blocker: Templates capture these as documents. Nothing ingests a metric or links a result to a decision as data.

criteria.title: Research operations: consent, recruiting status, retention, redaction and evidence lineage enforced
criteria.blocker: Not implemented; the discovery templates describe the practice without enforcing it.

categories.title: CI, packaging, migrations, releases, and maintainability

criteria.title: Every tracked Python file compiles
The full shipped test suite runs: root, harness, and regulated module
CI executes the runtime, not only the documents: compile, harness suite, adapters, workspace lifecycle and contract
The deletability guarantee holds: the tree gate passes with harness/ removed
Mutation checks prove CI catches syntax errors, path drift and semantically wrong links
Reproducible installation with pinned dependencies, forward migrations with rollback, backup and restore, and release provenance
criteria.blocker: Standard library only, so there is nothing to pin, but there is also no migration path for an existing workspace and no backup or restore runbook.

categories.title: UX, accessibility, onboarding, and adoption evidence

criteria.title: A documented golden path a new user can follow end to end, executed as a fixture
Worked examples exist and pass the full gate
Accessibility review and observed adoption evidence from a user who is not the maintainer
criteria.blocker: EXTERNAL: requires a real user session. No adoption telemetry or usability observation exists.
